Subject: IMS onboarding matrix & known listing exceptions

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Attached is the onboarding matrix from our side (ims_onboarding_matrix.xlsx) and a short list of items we expect to need an exception for on the marketplace listing during the initial launch window. High level:

- VPC-only deployment requirement for our regulated customers (we need a private deployment option pinned during verification)
- Custom billing flow (we invoice monthly; AWS MPA wants metered usage)
- Certain model binaries are under a restricted license; we may need a listing flag so customers know which models require a separate attestation

Can you confirm what level of exception the Redwood marketplace team can support and who your internal owners are for the technical gating? Elena

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IMS onboarding matrix & known listing exceptions

Elena — thanks for the matrix and the clear list. Read through the attachment and sketched out immediate gaps. Quick answers up front, then next steps:

- VPC-only: we can support private deployments (Redwood Private) but the marketplace listing needs to flag the product as "private-deployable"; that typically requires a catalog exception so customers see the option without public product artifacts.
- Billing: we have usage-based pricing on Redwood API, but we can support a Partner-billed flow for dedicated accounts. We will need procurement/legal to sign a partner billing addendum.
- Model licensing flags: we can add a UI badge and link to the attestation doc, but we'll need the licensing text from IMS legal.

Proposed next steps (can we confirm owners and target dates?):
1) Marketplace exception request (catalog flag + private-deployable badge) — owner: Tessa Morgan — target: request submitted by 2027-06-18
2) Technical runbook for VPC/on-prem install & verification — owner: Jonas Weber (tech contact) + IMS eng — target: draft by 2027-06-21
3) Billing addendum scope & procurement path — owner: Kar thik Iyer (sales ops) + Laura Bennett (finance) — target: LOI or mechanism by 2027-06-25

Can your legal/devops contacts share the short attestation wording and any hardened network diagrams? I can loop in Marketplace contact at AWS to see what their gating checklist will require.

Thanks — I will follow up internally and propose a 60-minute tech call tomorrow/Wednesday.

-jw

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: IMS onboarding — owners and exception triage

Team —

Looping you in on IMS (external thread below). They have three primary asks that intersect product, marketplace, and finance. I captured owners in my reply but want to confirm. Short summary and asks:

Background: IMS is an ISV targeting regulated customers; they want to list via the marketplace but require VPC-only deployment, partner-billed invoices, and license-attestation flags per model.

Asks:
- Marketplace flag/exception: we need a catalog exception request to show "Private-deployable / Partner-billed" on the listing without exposing public artifacts. Tessa — can you own the request and run the exception path? Include AWS contact if needed.
- Technical runbook: I will own the tech runbook draft with IMS engs. Need product input on the verification checklist (KV cache persistence, KMS/HSM integration, network egress rules).
- Billing flow: Kar thik / Laura — confirm whether we can do partner invoicing for the first year and what contract language is required. We may need a quick addendum.

Risks & blockers:
- S3 presigned URL requirement for model distribution may be blocked by marketplace policy; need legal review.
- Timeline tight if we want to land a preview listing by July.

Please reply with accept/decline and any immediate constraints. I will schedule a 60-minute alignment call for 2027-06-15 11:00 PDT if that works for people.

Thanks,
-jw

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: IMS onboarding — owners and exception triage

Jonas — I can take the marketplace playbook side and coordinate the exception request if Tessa needs a hand. Notes/answers:

- Marketplace exceptions: We have two flavors — a catalog flag (low friction) and a listing exception (higher friction; requires marketplace legal sign-off + AWS rep engagement). I'll prepare the initial mpa_exception_log.txt that lists required policy deviations and attach it to the request.
- Timeline: Catalog flag can be requested and often approved in ~7 business days; full exception often takes 2–3 weeks depending on AWS review. If we aim for a preview by July 10, we need the exception request in in the next 3 business days.
- Compliance docs: We need IMS's SOC/Security questionnaire responses and a network diagram. If they can provide those by EOW (2027-06-18), we can thread into the request.

I'll add the exception task to the INT-782 ticket and start drafting the small exception log. Attachments: mpa_exception_log.txt (draft).

-Marissa
